correctness.rationale: Entrywise prime-square GCD classification gives cI+s(I⊗J)+J. Unimodular difference and primitive-sum basis changes yield cI_{s(p-2)}, s-2 blocks T, and one K. Their determinantal divisors are (s,2p²s²) and (1,s,p²s²,6p⁴s⁴), so the displayed full invariant factors follow. The p=2 exception is direct. The finite checker found exact original-matrix Smith forms at p=2,3,5 and 4x4 minors at larger odd primes. No finite experiment is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The matrix is a natural arithmetic GCD-difference kernel on the primitive residue system modulo a prime square. It is the first nonsquarefree level and its integer cokernel is not determined by graph energy, rational eigenvalues or full-residue rank. The formula determines every torsion factor simultaneously for all primes, and exhibits a sharp unexpected cyclic 3-primary component for primes p≡2 mod3; this is substantive integral arithmetic information, not a routine determinant or finite table.
